lead_result_consumed.applied_fact: equal-predecessor extreme pair either span-descends to a shorter extreme pair or fork-escalates to exactly two later Hasse successor blockers

named_other_account_result_applied.application: linear-depth autonomous-chain migration rules out interpreting the new funnel as an O(1) or o(n) local-balance guarantee; the next step must remain a global mass argument

new_results: At a width-three two-cover fork above an equal-predecessor pair, the two sibling predecessor sets are necessarily nested; opposite lower witnesses would create a four-antichain.
For any strict nested pair Pred(y) proper_subset Pred(x), maximal elements of Pred(x)\Pred(y) are Hasse predecessors of x, incomparable with y, and number at most two.

Repeated clean equal-predecessor fork escalation is finite: each clean continuation moves both endpoints strictly right in the strong-majority total order, and the first exit is an extreme incomparable pair with strictly nested predecessor sets.
first_missing_implication: For the strict predecessor-nested endpoint x||y produced by the funnel, with endpoint-exchange quantities Q,R and E=e(P), prove 2E/3 <= Q+R <= 4E/3 from the global width-three heavy-slice/rank-atom/delayed-distinguisher constraints. By p_xy=1-(Q+R)/(2E), this yields a balanced pair.
